title: 你幫我挑的鏡框
subject: a very short-sighted man whose girlfriend picks his new frames at an optician by putting pair after pair on his face, and who, wearing the new lenses three days later, sees for the first time that she has more freckles on her left cheek
caption: Mandarin 2000s-style R&B-pop with stuttering syncopated drums. A muted, choppy funk guitar riff; beatbox-style programmed kicks and rimshots with finger snaps; a warm round sub bass; glassy electric piano chords. Clean, spacious early-2000s mix with an intimate lead. Male tenor, light breathy R&B delivery, soft falsetto on the hook, close-harmony backing vocals. 96 BPM, E-flat major. Tender, shy and smitten. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build, no orchestral ballad strings, no rock drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - muted guitar riff, beatbox-style percussion, finger snaps]

[Verse 1]
我近視八百度 不敢摘眼鏡
你說這副太老 像我爸
眼鏡行的鏡子前
你把一副一副往我臉上放

[Pre-Chorus]
圓的 方的 透明的
你退一步 歪著頭看

[Chorus]
就這副 你說就這副
我看不清楚 只看見你在笑
等我配好了鏡片
第一個要看清楚的是你

[Verse 2]
三天後去拿眼鏡
老闆幫我調好鼻墊
戴上那一秒 你的雀斑
原來左邊比右邊多

[Pre-Chorus]
你說幹嘛一直盯著
我說我在補三年的進度

[Chorus]
就這副 你說就這副
現在我看得清清楚楚
你耳朵後面那顆痣
我要一直看到老花

[Outro - snaps and muted guitar, soft humming]
